name: TinySearch
single_purpose: Display sourced research answers to questions from Destiny's stream within Destiny.gg chat, with local answer history, source links, and copy controls.
clipboardWrite: TinySearch uses clipboardWrite only when the user clicks a copy button on a TinySearch answer. The chat button writes the short answer with an @Destiny prefix so the user can paste it into chat; the detail view can copy the full answer and sources. The permission enables clipboard access from the content script in the embedded DGG chat. The extension does not read the clipboard, copy automatically, or submit chat messages.
storage: TinySearch uses chrome.storage.local to save display preferences, cache up to 200 recent public answers within seven days, and retain feed synchronization and release-check metadata across background-worker restarts. This supports searchable answer history, prevents duplicate cards, and avoids repeated network requests. These records are stored in the browser; search text, chat messages, and chat drafts are not stored.
host_permissions: TinySearch requests https://discord-relay-production-861c.up.railway.app/v1/answers to retrieve the public research answers displayed in DGG chat, and https://tinysearch.up.railway.app/v1/extension to retrieve public release notes and update notices. Host access is restricted to these two HTTPS services. The content script runs only on https://www.destiny.gg/embed/chat* and https://destiny.gg/embed/chat* to add the TinySearch interface and identify the embedded stream locally for filtering. It does not transmit native chat messages, chat drafts, search text, account data, or current video identifiers.
remote_code_explanation: TinySearch does not use remotely hosted executable code. All JavaScript, CSS, Markdown rendering, and SVG icon definitions are bundled in the submitted extension ZIP. Network responses contain public research answers and release metadata, parsed as JSON and rendered as inert content. The extension does not execute fetched scripts, use eval or Function to execute remote strings, or download executable updates.
detailed_description:
TinySearch displays sourced research answers alongside Destiny.gg chat at https://www.destiny.gg/bigscreen.

When TinySearch's research service answers a question from Destiny's stream, a short TinySearch card appears in your chat view. Each card includes a complete summary, up to two source links, a timestamp, and a clipboard button.

Choose Full answer to read the detailed answer and its sources. The answer history lets you search previous questions, browse older and newer answers, filter for the current YouTube stream when it can be identified, and open the stream at the moment a question was heard.

The chat clipboard button copies the summary with an @Destiny prefix so you can paste it yourself. The detailed answer has a separate copy button for the full response and sources.

Use the extension popup to enable or disable TinySearch, control whether answers appear in chat, and choose compact cards.

Answers are generated by AI and can contain mistakes. Review the linked sources. Answer availability depends on the public stream and the TinySearch research service.

The extension uses the current DGG page and embedded stream identifier locally to place its interface and filter answers. Display preferences and recent public answers are stored in your browser. Public answer and release requests connect to TinySearch's hosted services; their host receives standard connection information such as IP address and request timing. See the privacy policy for details.

TinySearch is an independently developed extension for use with Destiny.gg.
